description: ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind file for MCQ exam page in an online examination system, handling question loading, user interactions, and exam timing.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page, managing exam questions retrieval, user navigation, and timing.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial loading of exam questions from database based on course session, initializes timer.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to User Profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates exam mark based on selected answers, saves results to database, navigates to results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates exam timer display and handles timeout conditions.
